title: KPI
intro: The organization's measures for goals G-1 to G-5, computed from the event log and the documents in the system. Each shows its formula in words, its value for the chosen period, the baseline and the proposed target.
toInsights: See the executive summary: spending, budget, speed and control
forbidden: The KPI page is for executives, finance, procurement and auditors. If you need it, contact your organization admin.
forbiddenHead: The KPI page shows the whole organization's figures. Department heads read the KPI report of the departments they head on the reports page.
periodLine: {from} to {to} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}})
asOf: Figures read at {time} · times count business hours
periodInvalid: The chosen period cannot be used (it must start on or before its last day), so the last {days} days are shown instead.

baseline.noneTitle: No baseline to compare with yet
baseline.noneHint: The baseline is measured by hand by the customer's team and BCS during preparation, before go-live. Once it is recorded, the baseline column shows it next to this period's values. Until then, use the proposed targets as a guide.

figuresHint: Press a value to see the documents it counts.

table.caption: KPI G-1 to G-5: value for this period, baseline and proposed target

export.title: Export for the 60-day review
export.hint: A CSV file of the measures for the chosen period, each with its name, value, unit, numerator and denominator. It opens in Excel, and the export is recorded.

g1.name: POs approved through BCS
g1.formula: POs approved in the period ÷ all purchase documents in the accounting system, imported from Express every month
g1.target: At least 90% of all purchase documents

g2a.name: Approvals not by the DOA
g2a.formula: Decisions made by someone the DOA did not give the step to at the time, checked again with the DOA version's rules

g2b.name: Decisions citing the DOA version and rule
g2b.formula: Decisions that record the DOA version and rule they used ÷ all decisions in the period

g3a.name: Median time from request to first approved PO
g3a.formula: Half of the requests took no longer than this, in business hours from sending the request to the approval of its first PO
g3a.target: At least 50% less than the baseline

g3b.name: Median decision time per step
g3b.formula: Half of the approval steps were decided within this, in business hours from assignment to decision

g3c.name: Steps past due (SLA)
g3c.formula: Steps decided after their due time, or still open past it ÷ steps assigned in the period
g3c.stepsFormula: Every approval step assigned in the period, the denominator of Steps past due (SLA). Steps decided after their due time, or still open past it, are counted and come first; each says whether it is counted and why.

g4.name: Over-budget requests that reached an approver
g4.formula: Approval tasks of requests whose budget check failed when they were sent

g5.name: Decisions in LINE
g5.formula: Decisions made in LINE chat or on a screen in LINE ÷ all decisions in the period, in all and per kind of document
g5.byKindFormula: Decisions on {kind} made in LINE chat or on a screen in LINE ÷ all decisions on {kind} in the period

values.noDenominator: Not a share yet: it needs the number of purchase documents from the accounting system
values.checked: {count, plural, one {# decision checked} other {# decisions checked}}

stepsLinkLabel: See every step assigned in the period: {name} {detail}

items.unknownHint: Go back to the KPI page and press the value of the measure you want.
items.noneHint: Choose a wider period on the KPI page.
items.cappedCountedFirst: Showing {shown} of {total}: the counted ones first, then the latest
items.firstPoAt: First PO approved at {time}, {hours} business hours after the request was sent
items.decidedAfter: Decided at {time}, {hours} business hours after assignment

mark.WITH_DOA: Counted: cites the DOA version and rule
mark.WITHOUT_DOA: Not counted: does not cite the DOA version and rule
mark.MISROUTED: Counted: the decider is not who the DOA names
mark.DOA_MATCHED: Not counted: the decider is who the DOA names
mark.PAST_DUE_DECIDED: Counted: decided after its due time
mark.PAST_DUE_OPEN: Counted: still open past its due time
mark.DECIDED_ON_TIME: Not counted: decided by its due time
mark.OPEN_NOT_DUE: Not counted: still open, not due yet
mark.NO_DUE_TIME: Not counted: this step has no due time
mark.CLOSED_UNDECIDED: Not counted: closed without a decision (cancelled or reassigned)
